headline: Improve Fire tablet installation reliability checks

changes.title: Wait for the Fire tablet package service to respond
changes.detail: After cold boot, the Google-free tablet emulator now requires a responsive Android package manager before attempting installation, with bounded readiness checks and explicit failure evidence.

changes.title: Avoid streamed APK installation broken pipes
changes.detail: Fire tablet compatibility testing now uses bounded non-streaming APK installation and retries only recognized temporary ADB transport faults. Real installation rejection still fails.

changes.title: Verify the new tablet installation safeguards
changes.detail: The optional emulator contract checks package manager readiness, non-streaming installation, rejection handling, and installed-package verification without weakening release functional tests.
